FAQ | YES!Delft YES!Delft Search Menu Frequently Asked Questions Search Category All General Joining the incubator Validation Program Accelerator Program Startup Jobs Funding and investments Partners and collaborations Office and locations News and events Contacting YES!Delft General How many startups has YES!Delft supported? As of 2026, YES!Delft has supported more than 600 startups, 82% of which are still active or have been acquired, collectively raising over €1 billion in funding. What happens to startups after they finish a YES!Delft program? After completing the Accelerator, a startup becomes a YES!Delft alumni and keeps access to mentors, experts, investors, and partners for at least 5 years. This long-term support is reflected in the outcomes: of the 560+ startups YES!Delft has supported, 83% are still active or have been acquired. YES!Delft is widely regarded as one of the leading deeptech incubators & accelerators in Europe. What is the difference between the Validation Program, the Accelerator, and the Deep-dive tracks? The Validation Program helps early-stage founders test their business idea and reach first customers. The Accelerator supports startups that already have a validated idea and helps them scale, without taking equity. The Deep-dive (sector-focused) modules are targeted, industry-specific tracks layered on top of the Incubator (Validation) and
The Deep-dive (sector-focused) modules are targeted, industry-specific tracks layered on top of the Incubator (Validation) and Accelerator.

YES!Delft is a startup incubator and accelerator based in Delft, Netherlands, founded in 2005, affiliated with TU Delft, that supports deeptech startups from early validation through scale-up, connecting them with mentors, investors, and industry partners.
What support does YES!Delft provide to startups?
YES!Delft gives deeptech startups structured access to network, knowledge, talent, markets, capital, and facilities.

This includes programs, workshops, and masterclasses; a network of 100+ mentors and experts and 300+ investors; recruitment support drawing on TU Delft and Erasmus University; corporate and public-sector market connections; and facilities such as offices, the Makerzone, and field labs on the TU Delft campus.
Accelerator startups remain part of this ecosystem and receive support for at least 5 years.
In one sentence, what does YES!Delft do?
YES!Delft transforms scientific breakthroughs into globally scalable deeptech companies.
What is the difference between an incubator and an accelerator?

An incubator supports very early-stage startups as they shape and validate an idea over a flexible timeline, while an accelerator helps a more mature startup with a working product scale up through a fixed-term, structured program.

YES!Delft does both: the 10-week Validation Program acts as the incubator stage for founders still testing their idea, and the 3-month Accelerator is the structured scale-up program for startups that already have a prototype and early traction.
Is YES!Delft an incubator or an accelerator?

By using open source libraries and open standards FAQtory creates user friendly and scalable software. FAQtory links management of incoming e-mail to a dynamic FAQ page on the customer’s website. By providing answers directly on the website organisations can dramatically cut the cost of their customer support. FAQtory leverages the increasing quality of open source technologies and components available on the web today to deliver applications at lower cost with maximum performance and scalability. Team We provide tailored services with an extensive ecosystem to our startups, without taking equity. Ecosystem Together with our shareholders TU Delft, Municipality of Delft and the Erasmus University and many partners, investors, mentors, municipalities and other incubators and accelerators we are an ecosystem. Validation Program | YES!Delft YES!Delft Search Menu Incubator & accelerator Validation Program You have a clear business idea and technology, now it’s time to validate your idea and find your market. Apply Talk to a startup scout Whether you are validating a research-driven idea, building toward your first paying customers, or preparing for your first funding round, the YES!Delft Incubator gives you the framework, network, and mentorship to get there. A 10-week, part-time program for early-stage technology startups working toward problem–solution fit . Teams test assumptions through customer interviews, refine their target market and value proposition, and receive coaching on topics including business models, legal/IP, funding, team development and pitching. The Validation Program is open for complex hardware and digital startups. We help first time founders and experienced entrepreneurs that are looking to find the right customers and market and want to benefit from the mentors and experts in our ecosystem. The application process consists of an online submission, review by a startup scout, an intake conversation, a pitch-deck assignment and, for shortlisted teams, a Selection Day jury pitch.
